governing_principle: DONOR IDENTITY IS PROVENANCE. CAPABILITY IDENTITY BELONGS TO EKG.

rows.donor_evidence: BaseDataset.open_wfdb uses wfdb.rdsamp and preserves fields.fs.
rows.target_state: Target already has lib/wfdb_signal.js and DONOR-001 governed WFDB boundary.

rows.donor_evidence: Dataset adapters declare source lead order and compute reorder indices; upstream HEAD specifically fixes HEED/PTB-XL lead ordering.
rows.target_state: Input quality guard normalizes/validates lead identities but target lacks a reusable preprocessing contract that emits deterministic reorder indices and provenance.

rows.donor_evidence: BaseDataset changes sample rate when source sf differs from target_sf using cubic interpolation.
rows.target_state: Target has quality/provenance controls but no brand-neutral preprocessing contract that records source rate, target rate, whether resampling is required, and the declared method.
rows.constraint: Do not adopt cubic interpolation as clinical truth or runtime signal authority.

rows.donor_evidence: BaseDataset segments into non-overlapping segment_len samples and persists source/target sf and segment_len.
rows.target_state: No canonical reusable preprocessing metadata contract records segment sample count and derived duration.

rows.donor_evidence: Seven base dataset modules normalize heterogeneous paths/reports/lead arrangements.
rows.target_state: Target normalized dataset catalogue/provenance concepts under prior donors; direct dataset ingestion is not required for governed runtime.

rows.donor_evidence: MapDataset aligns research text objects to preprocessed ECG segment paths and contains a large vendored ECG-QA subtree.
rows.target_state: Target maintains strict source-label/project-gold separation and future primary donors cover ECG-QA/PULSE directly.
No need for unpinned generative translation in governed signal preprocessing.

rows.donor_evidence: Tokenizer code quantizes normalized waveform values and trains BPE; three tokenizer pickle artifacts are tracked.
rows.target_state: No target runtime need and no separately established artifact/training-data license or benchmark evidence.

rows.capability: Hugging Face upload and dataset publication
rows.donor_evidence: Repository includes upload tooling and scripts.
rows.target_state: Canonical target is not a dataset publishing pipeline.

rows.donor_evidence: Donor preprocessing paths tolerate per-record failures and aggregate progress; concurrent audit identified the need to make skipped-record reasons explicit.
rows.target_state: Target preprocessing contract did not yet reconcile attempted/processed/skipped records with categorized reasons.
rows.constraint: Reject silent or aggregate-only exception policy; no clinical interpretation is performed.

selected_harvest: brand-neutral twelve-lead source-order validation and deterministic reorder-index derivation
sampling-rate provenance contract with explicit resampling requirement/method declaration
fixed-sample segmentation provenance with derived duration
synthetic/adversarial tests proving no donor code/data/model artifact is required
auditable attempted/processed/skipped preprocessing accounting with categorized failure reasons
explicit_non_harvest: donor Python runtime or dependency stack
dataset waveforms, reports, source labels, QA JSON/CSV/TSV data
